rounds.text: Aurique Ltd is trading at a staggering discount to its earnings power, evidenced by a filed price-to-earnings ratio of just 2.05x [E1] and a key-ratios P/E of 2.45x [E6], which stands in profound contrast to the broader sector benchmark of 18.91x [E6]. This immense valuation gap is further underscored by a phenomenal return on assets of 106.96%, completely eclipsing the sector benchmark of 3.52% [E8]. Fundamental momentum is accelerating dramatically, highlighted by a scanX signal engine screen for earnings growth accelerating [E46] and year-over-year profit growth exceeding 20% [E45], backed by a stellar 54% compounded profit growth rate over the last 3 years [E16] and a solid 15% over 5 years [E15]. Even against a higher price-to-book ratio of 5.04x based on a price of ₹ 9.57 and a book value of ₹ 1.90 [E2], the sheer earnings velocity and micro-cap efficiency at a market capitalization of ₹ 1.25 Cr [E3] demonstrate that the market is severely undervaluing this cash-generative engine. Conceded: [E17].
